title: Topic 9
japanese_text:
A：CさんとDさんの喧嘩だけど、<u>それとなく</u><u>双方に</u>話を聞いてみたら、微妙に<u>食い違って</u>いたんだよね。
B：それで仲直りに時間がかかってるのか。これ以上2人の関係が<u>こじれる</u>前に、4人で会って話をした方がよさそうだね。
A：そうだね。2人とも<u>強情な</u>ところがあるし、それがいい。
english_translation: A: Ms. C and Mr. D were quarrelling, but when I indirectly asked both sides about it, I found they'd had a slight disagreement. B: Is that why it's taking so long for them to make up? The four of us should meet up and talk before things get any more complicated. A: Yes, they both have a stubborn streak. So that's a good idea.
